title: Te mura i roto i te whare rangatira o te whakapehapeha
intro: I muri i ngā taiepa nunui o te whare rangatira tino kaha o te ao tawhito i noho tētahi tangata nona te ngākau i pupuri i tētahi mea ngaro e kore e taea e tētahi ture kingi te whakamutu. I a ia e piko ana ki ngā atua teka, i pupuri tonu tēnei wairua i te whakapono marino e mura ana i roto. I whakapono te rangatira o taua whenua he atua rātou, engari i whiriwhiria e tēnei tangata te pono i runga i te whakamarie, me te aroha i runga i te haumaru. I tēnei rā, ko tāu mahi he kimi ko wai tēnei wairua toa, ko tōna kōrero tonu tētahi o ngā tauira tino kaha o te whakapono pumau.
clues: I noho ahau i tētahi wāhi whai rawa nui, whai mana nui, ā, kāore he rite o te rangatiratanga, i reira ko te rangatira o te whenua te mana tino nui ki runga i te katoa.
I a te hunga i tōku taha e piko ana ki ngā atua teka, i puritia e ahau he māramatanga marino o te whakapono i roto i tōku ngākau.
I kitea e au, ā, i whāngaihia e au tētahi tamaiti i kawea mai ki ahau i tētahi ara rerekē - ehara i te mea nā te whānautanga, engari nā roto i ngā wai o tētahi awa nui.
I inoi ahau ki tōku Ariki, me te tono kia tukuna mai he kāinga e tata ana ki a Ia i Pararaiha, me te whakaoranga mai i te tukino i karapoti i ahau.
I tipu ake te tamaiti i whakatipuria e au ki te wero i te rangatira tonu nāna nei i whakahaere tōku aituā, ā, i tū pakari tonu ahau ki tōku whakapono ahakoa i whakawehihia ahau.
Ko au te tangata kua whakanuia tōna ingoa i roto i te Quran hei tauira whakapono, ā, i noho ahau i roto i te whare kingi o Parao tonu.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Asiya, te wahine a Parao
Ko Meriama, te whaea o Īha
Ko Bilqis, te Kuīni o Sheba
Te wahine a te Poropiti a Ruta
Te wahine a Imran

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te kitenga me te whakatipu i tētahi pēpi kua whakarērea, ā, i riro hei poropiti nui
Te maka ki roto i te ahi nui e te kaitukino
Te kitenga i tētahi waipuke nui i whakangaro i tētahi iwi
Te mātakitaki i te rūrūtanga o te nikau tāte, me te whakarato i te kai
Te hapu i te tamaiti ahakoa te pakeketanga
trial.answer: Te kitenga me te whakatipu i tētahi pēpi kua whakarērea, ā, i riro hei poropiti nui

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: He whare kingi, he ataahua whakaharahara
He kaipuke nui i hangaia hei tū atu i te waipuke
He ana hohonu e huna ana i roto i ngā maunga
He ahi mura i hangaia ki runga i te tihi o te maunga
He māra kua karapotia e ngā taiepa
location.answer: He whare kingi, he ataahua whakaharahara

outcome.label: Hua
options: I homai he kāinga ki Pararaiha i runga i te hiahia o Allah
I whakangaromia te hunga whakaponokore o tētahi iwi tawhito e te waipuke nui
I tukuna he rangatiratanga nui whakaharahara me te mana ki tēnei ao
I marara noa atu tētahi ope nui e ngā manu e rere ana
I toremitia te tangata nanakia i kī he atua ia ki te moana
outcome.answer: I homai he kāinga ki Pararaiha i runga i te hiahia o Allah

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
